ننتكس (form VIII)
# نَنْتَكِسُ (nantakisu) /nan.ta.ki.su/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَكَسَ (intakasa)
# نَنْتَكِسَ (nantakisa) /nan.ta.ki.sa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَكَسَ (intakasa)
# نَنْتَكِسْ (nantakis) /nan.ta.kis/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْتَكَسَ (intakasa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
